verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA in the top-left, ahead of the headline and the logo, which breaks the reading order. The logo is pushed to the top right, the list is crammed under the headline with shrinking font sizes and drifting dots, and the list order is changed. The bottom quarter of the canvas is empty. B has a sensible top-to-bottom flow (logo, can, headline, list, CTA), but the logo is tiny and sits off-centre. The flavour list shrinks item by item with ragged, staggered dots, is out of the original order, and is cramped under the headline. The CTA text is small and there is a dead band at the bottom.
